This program will synergize its strategies and implementation with the successful DFAT’s INOVASI program. Develop and oversee contingency and risk-mitigation plans with partners to ensure program continuity in the event of unforeseen challenges. Ensure child safeguarding is integrated into all program activities, including conducting and reviewing partner risk assessments and ensuring mitigation measures are implemented so that child safeguarding is enforced across partner organizations. Representation, Stakeholder Engagement and External Communications Maintain clear, timely, and effective communication with KREASI national office team members, implementing partners, and relevant Save the Children Indonesia teams. Lead the development of constructive relationships with government authorities at provincial and district levels. Represent Save the Children and the KREASI program in local and regional forums, coordination meetings, and external events to advance program objectives, partnerships, and policy engagement. Address underperformance through documented performance improvement plans and ensure accountability for professional conduct and results. Ensure continuous professional development opportunities are available to build and maintain the technical and managerial capacity required for effective partner oversight. Financial and administrative management Oversee regional program budgets in collaboration with Head of Finance and the Head of Operation, ensuring efficient allocation and close monitoring of expenditures, including implementing partner budgets. Ensure partners comply with donor financial regulations, partnership agreements, and Save the Children financial policies, and address any variances or risks proactively. Oversee the production of accurate financial reports, forecasts, and documentation for audits and donor submissions. Work with local governments to support alignment of government funding (from provincial to school level) with program objectives and GPE budgets, promoting efficient and complementary use of resources.
